skills.name: Courtesy (礼教/礼儀作法)
skills.line: Fortune is right here. Don't get too greedy.
skills.description: SP Ebisu swings his fishing rod to catch a goldfish that strikes a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Fortune Landing (洪福降臨/幸運降臨)
skills.line: Keep your feet on the ground, because every bit counts.
skills.description: Fortune favors the diligent. At the end SP Ebisu's turn, he decreases all enemies' move bar by 10%. If Great Responsibility was used in the turn, he begins to Snooze, sustained for 1 turn. ;Snooze (打盹/昏睡) :SP Ebisu begins to Sleep. If Sleep is removed while he's Snoozing, he recovers the HP of all non-summoned allies by 14% of his max HP.

upgrades.text: Decrease to enemies' move bar effect increases to 15%.
At the end of turn, grants 2 onibi.
When he's Snoozing, grants 1 additional onibi.
At the start of battle and when he receives damage for the first time, he'll begin to Snooze.

skills.name: Great Responsibility (委以重任/他力本願)
skills.line: Granting divine blessings is a great responsibility, I'm just going to... take a nap first.
skills.description:
SP Ebisu recovers the HP of 1 non-summoned ally by 14% of his max HP and has a 50% of transferring the 4-set of his equipped souls (up to 1 effect can be transferred, total damage boost from all souls is maxed out at 140%), sustained for 1 turn.
When used on an ally who has the souls-transferring effect again, he dispels or removes all control effects on them instead; if the ally is not inflicted with any control effects, he grants them a new turn and removes the soul-transferring effect at the end of that new turn.

bio.condition: Team SP Ebisu with another player's Ebisu and clear any zone 10 times.
